negroni.name: Negroni
negroni.description: Gin, bitter aperitif and sweet vermouth.
steps: Add gin, Campari and sweet vermouth to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until chilled; strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.
Express an orange peel over the drink and garnish.

manhattan.name: Manhattan
manhattan.description: Whiskey, sweet vermouth and aromatic bitters.
steps: Add whiskey, vermouth and bitters to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until chilled; strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish with a cocktail cherry.

daiquiri.name: Daiquiri
daiquiri.description: White rum, fresh lime and sugar.
steps: Stir rum, lime juice and sugar in a shaker until the sugar dissolves.
Add ice and shake until chilled.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.

mojito.name: Mojito
mojito.description: Rum, lime and mint topped with soda.
steps: Gently press mint with sugar and lime juice in a highball without shredding the leaves.
Add rum and stir, then fill the glass with ice.
Top with soda water and stir gently. Do not shake carbonated ingredients.

old-fashioned.name: Old Fashioned
steps: Saturate the sugar cube with bitters and water in a rocks glass; crush and stir to dissolve.
Add bourbon and a large ice cube, then stir until chilled.
Express an orange peel over the drink and garnish.

dry-martini.name: Dry Martini
dry-martini.description: Gin and dry vermouth, stirred and served up.
steps: Add gin and dry vermouth to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until well chilled and strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist or an olive.

vodka-martini.name: Vodka Martini
vodka-martini.description: Vodka and dry vermouth, stirred and served up.
steps: Add vodka and dry vermouth to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until well chilled; strain into a chilled martini glass.
Express a lemon twist over the surface and garnish.

margarita.name: Margarita
margarita.ice: Shaking ice; served up or over fresh cubes
margarita.description: Tequila, orange liqueur and fresh lime.
steps: Optionally salt half the rim of a chilled glass.
Shake tequila, triple sec and lime juice with ice until chilled.
Strain into the glass, either up or over fresh ice, and garnish with lime.

whiskey-sour.name: Whiskey Sour
whiskey-sour.description: Bourbon, lemon and sugar with an optional silky foam.
whiskey-sour.allergens: Egg if optional egg white is used
steps: Combine bourbon, lemon juice and syrup in a shaker; add optional pasteurized egg white.
If using egg white, shake without ice first. Then add ice and shake until chilled.
Fine-strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice and garnish.

cosmopolitan.name: Cosmopolitan
cosmopolitan.description: Citrus vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and lime.
steps: Shake vodka, triple sec, cranberry juice and lime juice with ice.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.
Express an orange peel over the surface and garnish.

moscow-mule.name: Moscow Mule
moscow-mule.description: Vodka and lime topped with ginger beer.
steps: Fill a mug or highball with ice and add vodka and lime juice.
Top with ginger beer and stir gently.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

gin-tonic.name: Gin and Tonic
gin-tonic.description: Gin and tonic water over ice.
steps: Fill a highball with ice and add gin.
Top with chilled tonic water and stir gently.
Garnish with lime.

tom-collins.name: Tom Collins
tom-collins.description: Gin, lemon and sugar lengthened with soda.
steps: Shake gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice; keep soda water out of the shaker.
Strain into a Collins glass over fresh ice.
Top with soda water, stir gently and garnish with lemon.

rum-coke.name: Rum and Coke
steps: Fill a highball with ice and add rum.
Top with chilled cola and stir gently.

cuba-libre.name: Cuba Libre
steps: Add rum and lime juice to an ice-filled highball.
Top with cola and stir gently.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

bloody-mary.name: Bloody Mary
bloody-mary.description: Vodka and tomato juice with lemon and savory seasonings.
bloody-mary.allergens: Fish in traditional Worcestershire sauce; celery
steps: Combine vodka, tomato juice, lemon juice and seasonings in a mixing glass.
Add ice and stir gently to chill without aerating the tomato juice.
Pour into a highball and garnish with celery. Adjust seasoning to the house specification.

screwdriver.name: Screwdriver
screwdriver.description: Vodka and orange juice over ice.
steps: Add vodka to an ice-filled highball.
Add orange juice and stir to combine.
Garnish with orange.

tequila-sunrise.name: Tequila Sunrise
tequila-sunrise.description: Tequila and orange juice with a grenadine sunrise.
steps: Add tequila and orange juice to an ice-filled highball and stir.
Slowly pour grenadine down the inside of the glass so it settles toward the bottom; do not stir again.
Garnish with orange.

mai-tai.name: Mai Tai
mai-tai.description: Aged rum, orange curacao, lime and orgeat.
steps: Shake rum, curacao, lime juice, orgeat and syrup with ice.
Strain into a rocks glass over crushed ice.
Garnish with mint and a spent lime shell if available.

pina-colada.name: Pina Colada
pina-colada.description: Rum, pineapple and cream of coconut.
pina-colada.allergens: Coconut; check cream of coconut label for other allergens
steps: Add rum, pineapple juice, cream of coconut and a loosely filled 120 ml measure of crushed ice to a blender.
Blend until smooth, adjusting ice to the desired texture.
Pour into a hurricane glass and garnish with pineapple.

espresso-martini.name: Espresso Martini
espresso-martini.description: Vodka, coffee liqueur and espresso with a foamy finish.
steps: Combine vodka, coffee liqueur, espresso and syrup in a shaker.
Add plenty of ice and shake firmly until chilled and foamy.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with three coffee beans.

aperol-spritz.name: Aperol Spritz
aperol-spritz.description: Prosecco, Aperol and soda over ice.
steps: Fill a wine glass with ice and add prosecco and Aperol.
Top with soda water and stir gently.
Garnish with orange.

french-75.name: French 75
french-75.description: Gin, lemon and sugar topped with sparkling wine.
steps: Shake gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice; keep the sparkling wine out of the shaker.
Strain into a chilled flute.
Top with Champagne and garnish with a lemon twist.

sidecar.name: Sidecar
steps: Optionally coat half the rim of a chilled coupe with sugar.
Shake cognac, triple sec and lemon juice with ice.
Fine-strain into the coupe and garnish with orange peel.

sazerac.name: Sazerac
sazerac.description: Rye whiskey, sugar and Peychaud's bitters in an absinthe-rinsed glass.
steps: Rinse a chilled rocks glass with absinthe and discard the excess.
Stir whiskey, syrup and bitters with ice in a mixing glass.
Strain into the rinsed glass without ice; express a lemon peel over the drink.

boulevardier.name: Boulevardier
steps: Stir bourbon, Campari and vermouth with ice in a mixing glass.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.
Express an orange peel over the drink and garnish.

paloma.name: Paloma
paloma.description: Tequila and lime topped with grapefruit soda.
steps: Optionally salt half the rim of a highball and fill it with ice.
Add tequila and lime juice, then top with grapefruit soda.
Stir gently and garnish with grapefruit if available.

mint-julep.name: Mint Julep
mint-julep.description: Bourbon, mint and sugar over crushed ice.
steps: Gently press mint leaves with syrup in a julep cup without shredding them.
Add bourbon, fill with crushed ice and stir until the cup is chilled.
Top with more crushed ice and garnish with mint.

white-russian.name: White Russian
steps: Add vodka and coffee liqueur to a rocks glass over ice and stir.
Pour cream over the top.
Serve layered or stir gently to combine, according to the house specification.

long-island-iced-tea.name: Long Island Iced Tea
long-island-iced-tea.description: Vodka, gin, rum, tequila and orange liqueur with lemon and cola.
steps: Shake the spirits, triple sec, lemon juice and syrup with ice; do not add cola to the shaker.
Strain into a highball over fresh ice.
Top with cola, stir gently and garnish with lemon.

shirley-temple.name: Shirley Temple
shirley-temple.description: Ginger ale and grenadine with a cherry garnish.
steps: Fill a highball with ice and add grenadine.
Top with ginger ale and stir gently.
Garnish with a cocktail cherry.

virgin-mojito.name: Virgin Mojito
virgin-mojito.description: Fresh lime, mint and sugar topped with soda.
steps: Gently press mint with lime juice and syrup in a highball.
Fill with ice and top with soda water.
Stir gently and garnish with mint.

lime-soda.name: Lime Soda
lime-soda.description: Fresh lime and soda with a touch of sweetness.
steps: Add lime juice and syrup to a highball and stir.
Fill with ice, top with soda water and stir gently.
